title: Blessings window: Players tab with per-player blessings and tank marks
description: Per-player blessings are hidden behind Shift-click and the tank list is a separate /lb page, so a player who wants another blessing than their class keeps getting nagged/overwritten. Gather it in the Blessings window.
design: Approved 2026-11-18. Tabs in the Blessings window header: Classes (existing grid) | Players. Players: one line per group member (raid: sorted by group with group headers, scrolls): name in class colour, class, the blessing YOU give them, tank checkbox. Blessing cell: grey = follows class (or tank fallback), gold = per-player override. Left/right-click cycles (BlessOptions incl. 0 = follow class), Shift-click resets to the class. Uses ns.SetNormalAssign (PallyPower NASSIGN, shared) and ns.SetTank. Effective blessing shown via ns.PB.Assignment so tank fallback shows. Tanks page in /lb stays (tankGuard toggle, names outside the group). Footer in Players tab: 'Follow class for all' clears your overrides for current members. Tab remembered in ns.db.rwTab.
notes: Implemented in RaidWindow.lua (Players tab). Awaiting in-game test.
close_reason: Checked in game by the user

title: Tracker: Unsealed Wrath stored-seal stacks
description: Ret talent (spell 1310735, passive): melee stores a copy of the active Seal for 15s, up to 3 stacks; attacking with a different Seal consumes them. Show stored seal icon, stack count, 15s countdown, proc glow at 3. Needs the stack buff's spell ID from /lb auras in game; check whether it is hidden in combat.
notes:
Research 2026-11-18: Unsealed Wrath replaced Twist of Light on Nov 2 (spell 1310735 was Twist of Light per ForeverAuras PlayerSpecialization.lua; UW's own ID unknown). 31-pt ret talent, requires Repentance. Melee stores active Seal copy 15s, max 3; landing a hit with a different Seal consumes all, each stack gets the stored Seal's normal proc chance. Common twist: SoC x3 swings, swap to SoR just before 4th swing, swap back. Judgement 10s cd, does not consume seal. Holy Strike 10s cd. Client facts: no combat log (12.0 base); PLAYER_SWING(duration, swingType) + C_SwingTimer exist (Ellesmere/ForeverAuras use them). Unknown: stored-seal buff ID/name, whether its stacks and the active seal aura are readable in combat.
In game 2026-11-18: buffs Echo of Command 1311703 and Echo of Righteousness 1311704 (stacks = applications, 15s). Seal of Command aura 20918, Seal of Righteousness 20291 (30s). In combat GetAuraDataByIndex errors: 'Auras cannot be accessed when secret while tainted'. Next: /bk watch to see whether PLAYER_SWING and UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED spell IDs are readable in combat.
Built 2026-11-18 as the Twist bar (Twist.lua, TwistLogic.lua, tests/test_twist.lua, design/2026-11-18-twist-bar-design.md). Waiting for the in-game check.
close_reason: Twist bar with native Echo pips checked in game by the user

title: Buff key: skip SetAttribute when macrotext is unchanged, stop ticker when disabled
description: PartyBuff.lua 2s ticker scans up to 40 units x 40 auras and rewrites macrotext every time. Skip unchanged attributes, stop when pbEnabled is off, consider raid UNIT_AURA with updateInfo.

title: Shared player-aura read cached per UNIT_AURA
description: Six modules call ns.ReadPlayerBuffs on every player UNIT_AURA (40 pcalls each) plus the Blessings 1s ticker. Cache in Core, invalidate on UNIT_AURA player / combat change.

title: Cleanse: repaint range on the ticker instead of rescanning every unit's auras
description: Cleanse.lua:711 ticker (0.5s) calls M:Update, which rescans up to 40x40 auras plus Units()/GetRaidRosterInfo, even in list mode at alpha 0. Use UNIT_AURA (updateInfo) for debuffs and only refresh range on the ticker; consider HARMFUL|RAID filter.

title: Clean() helpers compare with nil before the secret check
description: Announce, Cleanse, Combat, Cooldowns, Judgements, Requests, Tanks, Trackers define Clean(v) as 'v == nil or isSecret(v)'. Core.lua says a secret can't even be compared with nil. Swap the order (or use one shared ns.Clean). Found by Codex while reviewing Twist.lua.

title: Docs screenshots without manual work: scripted capture in Barkeep
description: Idea from Marius: avoid taking docs screenshots by hand. Plan: a private Barkeep command (dev tools stay out of public Lightbound) that shows each frame in a test state, opens each options page in turn, records frame rects (GetRect * effective scale) in SavedVariables and calls Screenshot(); a local script then crops the PNGs from the Screenshots folder into docs/screenshots/. Run once per skin. Rendering frames outside the game from extracted Blizzard textures was rejected: it reimplements the UI (drifts from the real code) and puts Blizzard assets in a public repo.
notes: Built in Barkeep (commit on main): /bk shots + tools/crop_shots.py. Untested in game: Screenshot() from a timer, the screenshotFormat CVar, crop alignment.
